methodology.priority_policy: Rank demand clusters using reported search volume, breadth of related queries, competition notes, and implementation feasibility.
methodology.volume_policy: Use only source-reported search volumes; rankings are directional and are not traffic forecasts.
methodology.existing_tool_policy: Prefer new tools where the current 35-tool registry has no direct functional match.

queue.rationale: Multiple strong related queries support one reusable browser-based image resizing capability, creating a broad long-tail page cluster.
A focused utility with a reported 48K search-demand signal and low implementation complexity is a strong next build.
Demand is exceptionally strong, but the evidence explicitly indicates entrenched competition; validate differentiation and SERP feasibility before implementation.
